notes: Each segment is a quintic rest-to-rest curve: s(u)=10u^3-15u^4+6u^5.
Duration safety factor raised from 1.25 to 1.50 to reduce simulated acceleration; acceleration limits are unchanged.
Dynamics use the original MuJoCo position actuators plus qfrc_bias/kp control bias compensation.
Plant display meshes are not physics colliders. Full source triangles are checked externally on every reference and simulated state.
Hard checks use the configured conservative robot covers and adaptive native volume bounds. Soft scores include original robot visual meshes when enabled in the saved scene.
Soft scores measure geometric exposure, not measured force or plant damage. Slower timing also changes contact duration and must be rescored.
The final hold is a one-second preview pause, not an actual watering flow command.
